sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to Speaking of Psychology, a podcast produced by the American Psychological
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听《心理学之声》（Speaking of Psychology），这是一档由美国心理学会

sentences.en: Association.
sentences.zh: （American Psychological Association）制作的播客。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Kim Mills, and I'm speaking to you from APA's Technology, Mind, and Society Conference in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人金·米尔斯（Kim Mills），我在华盛顿特区举行的美国心理学会“技术、思维与社会”会议上为您进行现场采访。

sentences.en: This is an interdisciplinary meeting aimed at assessing current efforts to understand and shape the interactions of human beings and technology
sentences.zh: 这是一场跨学科会议，旨在评估当前理解和塑造人类与技术互动关系的各项努力，

sentences.en: for identifying priorities for future work and for promoting exchange of ideas and collaboration among participants.
sentences.zh: 确定未来工作的重点，并促进与会者之间的思想交流与合作。

sentences.en: David Friedman is the Director of Cars and Product Policy and
sentences.zh: 大卫·弗里德曼（David Friedman）是消费者联盟（Consumers Union）汽车与产品政策及

sentences.en: Analysis for Consumers Union, the policy arm of Consumer Reports that focuses on product testing and consumer safety.
sentences.zh: 分析总监。消费者联盟是《消费者报告》（Consumer Reports）旗下的政策机构，专注于产品测试和消费者安全。

sentences.en: Mr. Friedman serves as a thought leader across Consumer Reports and leads Consumers
sentences.zh: 弗里德曼先生在整个《消费者报告》中担任思想领袖，领导消费者

sentences.en: Union's public policy and analytical efforts to ensure automobiles and other products are safe
sentences.zh: 联盟的公共政策和分析工作，以确保汽车和其他产品对消费者而言是安全的，

sentences.en: for consumers, to improve consumer options for energy efficiency and cleaner energy, and to guide other important initiatives.
sentences.zh: 提升消费者在能源效率和清洁能源方面的选择，并指导其他重要倡议。

sentences.en: An engineer, he previously served as both Deputy and Acting Administrator of the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration and was Deputy Assistant Secretary for the Office of
sentences.zh: 作为一名工程师，他曾任美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）的副局长和代理局长，并曾担任美国

sentences.en: Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 能源部能源效率与可再生能源办公室的

sentences.en: Department of Energy.
sentences.zh: 副助理部长。

sentences.en: Mr. Friedman also worked for 12 years at the Union of Concerned Scientists as Senior Engineer, Research Director, and Deputy Director of their Clean Vehicles Program.
sentences.zh: 弗里德曼还在忧思科学家联盟（Union of Concerned Scientists）工作了12年，担任高级工程师、研究总监以及清洁汽车项目副总监。

sentences.en: Thanks for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 感谢您今天加入我们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: So I'd like to start by talking about self-driving cars.
sentences.zh: 我想先从自动驾驶汽车开始聊起。

sentences.en: And my first question is whether Consumers Union has a position on the need for and feasibility of self-driving cars at this point.
sentences.zh: 我的第一个问题是，消费者联盟目前对自动驾驶汽车的需求和可行性持什么立场？

sentences.en: Well, we're really excited about the potential for cars that can drive themselves.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们对自动驾驶汽车的潜力感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I mean, just think of a world where it doesn't matter whether you have a disability, what your age is, or what your driving capability is, you can have mobility and access
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，想象一下这样一个世界：无论你是否有残疾、年龄多大、驾驶能力如何，你都能够获得出行便利，

sentences.en: all over your city or town.
sentences.zh: 走遍你的城市或小镇。

sentences.en: Plus, if you combine those self-driving cars with electric cars and car sharing, we could dramatically lower costs for consumers while increasing mobility and lowering emissions.
sentences.zh: 此外，如果你将自动驾驶汽车与电动汽车和汽车共享结合起来，我们就能在增加出行便利和减少排放的同时，大幅降低消费者的成本。

sentences.en: So the potential is amazing.
sentences.zh: 因此，其潜力是惊人的。

sentences.en: But that word potential is important.
sentences.zh: 但“潜力”这个词很关键。

sentences.en: The reality is the technology of self-driving cars in many ways is at best equivalent to a novice driver or a teen driver.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，在许多方面，自动驾驶汽车的技术充其量只相当于一个新手司机或青少年司机。

sentences.en: There's a lot of work that still needs to be done.
sentences.zh: 还有很多工作需要做。

sentences.en: So are we ready psychologically for self-driving cars?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们在心理上准备好迎接自动驾驶汽车了吗？

sentences.en: I think that is a fantastic and really critical question.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常棒且至关重要的问题。

sentences.en: Because when I look at self-driving cars, one of the things that I think is important is to make sure we design automation for humans instead
sentences.zh: 因为当我审视自动驾驶汽车时，我认为重要的一点是确保我们为人类设计自动化，而

sentences.en: of trying to design humans for automation, because we will fail at that latter task.
sentences.zh: 不是试图让人类去适应自动化，因为后一项任务注定会失败。

sentences.en: Human-centered automation is going to be the key to success here.
sentences.zh: 以人为本的自动化将是这里成功的关键。

sentences.en: And that means understanding more about how people are going to interact with this technology.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要更多地了解人们将如何与这项技术进行交互。

sentences.en: What are the pros and cons of self-driving cars?
sentences.zh: 自动驾驶汽车的利弊是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I think it cuts both ways.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为它有利有弊。

sentences.en: Well, when I think of self-driving cars, I kind of think about we have two possible futures with this technology.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我想到自动驾驶汽车时，我脑海里会浮现出这项技术的两种可能未来。

sentences.en: In one future, we have a utopia where we have better mobility, we effectively eliminate traffic crashes, we cut costs, and have a great convenience feature for
sentences.zh: 在一种未来里，我们拥有一个乌托邦，出行更加便利，交通事故被有效消除，成本降低，并且为

sentences.en: consumers so they can get wherever they want to go whenever they want to go.
sentences.zh: 消费者提供了一项极大的便利功能，让他们随时随地都能去想去的地方。

sentences.en: That's the utopia situation.
sentences.zh: 这就是乌托邦式的状况。

sentences.en: The dystopian world is where we have self-driving cars that aren't safe, put people at
sentences.zh: 而反乌托邦的世界则是，我们的自动驾驶汽车并不安全，将人们置于

sentences.en: risk, that increase the amount we travel and increase the emissions we create, and create a world where
sentences.zh: 危险之中，增加了我们的出行量，增加了我们产生的排放，并创造了一个世界——

sentences.en: we're all basically locked into our cars instead of spending time with our family and friends.
sentences.zh: 在这个世界里，我们基本上都被锁在车里，而不是花时间陪伴家人和朋友。

sentences.en: So you mentioned the possibility of fewer accidents, and of course there's been a lot of publicity around
sentences.zh: 所以你提到了事故减少的可能性，当然，最近亚利桑那州发生了优步（Uber）撞死骑车人的事故，这引起了大量关注。

sentences.en: the accident that just happened in Arizona where the Uber hit a cycliSt. What went wrong there?
sentences.zh: 那里究竟出了什么问题？

sentences.en: I mean, why didn't the car know that the cyclist was there?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为什么汽车没有发现那个骑车人在那儿？

sentences.en: Well, you know, there's several investigations going on, so I always want to be careful not to prejudge.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，目前有几项调查正在进行，所以我总是提醒自己要小心，不要妄下定论。

sentences.en: We have two federal agencies that are going to dive in and try to understand the details.
sentences.zh: 我们将有两家联邦机构介入并试图弄清细节。

sentences.en: What I've observed from the video associated with it is a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 从相关的视频中，我观察到了几点。

sentences.en: One, it looks like the system wasn't capable of stopping in time in approaching a pedestrian in the dark.
sentences.zh: 第一，看起来该系统在黑暗中接近行人时，无法及时刹车。

sentences.en: That's shocking.
sentences.zh: 这太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: I mean, when we think of self-driving cars, we think of a car that's going to be safer than a human driver.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我们想到自动驾驶汽车时，我们认为它应该比人类司机更安全。

sentences.en: So that's one thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一点。

sentences.en: It looks like the technology wasn't up to task.
sentences.zh: 看来这项技术还不过关。

sentences.en: The second thing is they had a human in the driver's seat who was supposed to be there to take over in case of an emergency, but the human was distracted.
sentences.zh: 第二点是，他们的驾驶座上坐着一个人类，本该在紧急情况下接管车辆，但这个人分心了。

sentences.en: And what that tells me is something I think we all already know.
sentences.zh: 这向我说明了一点，我想这也是我们大家早就心知肚明的。

sentences.en: Humans aren't very good at watching paint dry.
sentences.zh: 人类并不擅长盯着油漆变干。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the job of these folks is to try to pay close attention to everything that's going on around them in a car that's supposed to be able to drive itself.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些人的工作就是在本应能够自主驾驶的汽车里，密切关注周围发生的一切。

sentences.en: That is a very difficult task.
sentences.zh: 这是一项非常艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: These cars should have driver monitoring systems to make sure that safety driver is actually paying attention.
sentences.zh: 这些汽车应该配备驾驶员监测系统，以确保安全员确实在聚精会神。

sentences.en: I would say the biggest thing that went wrong here, though, is fundamental human error in the design, testing, and rush to market of these self-driving cars.
sentences.zh: 不过，我要说的是，这里出的最大问题在于自动驾驶汽车在设计、测试和急于上市的过程中出现了根本性的人为错误。

sentences.en: And yet we've been talking about self-driving cars for something like 50 years, right?
sentences.zh: 然而，我们谈论自动驾驶汽车已经有大约50年了，对吧？

sentences.en: So how are we rushing to market?
sentences.zh: 那么我们怎么能说它是仓促上市呢？

sentences.en: So if you think about automation in cars, we've actually been increasingly automating cars for over
sentences.zh: 如果你回想一下汽车中的自动化技术，事实上，过去

sentences.en: 100 years, actually.
sentences.zh: 100多年来，汽车自动化程度一直在不断提高。

sentences.en: I mean, originally you had to walk up to a car and literally crank the engine to get it started.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，最初你必须走到车前，字面意义上去摇动手柄来启动发动机。

sentences.en: And then we created starter motors.
sentences.zh: 然后我们发明了起动机。

sentences.en: So from starter motors to self-driving cars, we've had basically an evolution of automation in our cars.
sentences.zh: 因此，从起动机到自动驾驶汽车，我们的汽车经历了一场基本上属于演进式的自动化历程。

sentences.en: But what's different now is that the computing power and sensors available to car companies and tech companies is light years ahead of where we've been.
sentences.zh: 但现在不同的是，汽车公司和科技公司所能获得的计算能力和传感器技术，比我们过去的水平领先了不知多少光年。

sentences.en: And they're now trying to figure out how to apply that to cars.
sentences.zh: 他们现在正试图弄清楚如何将这些应用到汽车上。

sentences.en: So why does that mean we're rushing things now?
sentences.zh: 那为什么这就意味着我们现在是在仓促行事呢？

sentences.en: Well, the problem is there's so much money to be made from a world of self-driving
sentences.zh: 嗯，问题在于，自动驾驶汽车的世界里蕴藏着巨大的商机，

sentences.en: cars that companies appear to be rushing to test these vehicles on our roads and sell these vehicles
sentences.zh: 以至于各家公司似乎都在急于将这些车辆推上我们的道路进行测试，并急于把这些车辆

sentences.en: on our roads before they have demonstrated and proven that they're actually safe to be on our roads.
sentences.zh: 卖到我们的道路上，甚至在它们被论证和证明真正能够安全上路之前。

sentences.en: So what do you think ultimately is the role of the human being inside a self-driving car?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为自动驾驶汽车内部的人类最终扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: Well, I think really, the big question is both, what is the role of the human inside the self-driving car?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为真正的大问题其实有两个：一个是自动驾驶汽车内部人类的角色是什么？

sentences.en: But also, what is the role of the human being in the design, manufacture, and approach and governance of self-driving cars?
sentences.zh: 另一个是人类在自动驾驶汽车的设计、制造、研发方法以及监管中扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: I mean, hopefully, in the long term, we'll get to a world where cars are truly smart enough and capable of driving themselves.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，希望从长远来看，我们会迎来这样一个世界：汽车真的足够聪明，能够自主驾驶。

sentences.en: But we're only going to get there if we recognize that self-driving cars do not eliminate human error.
sentences.zh: 但我们要想实现这一点，前提是必须认识到自动驾驶汽车并不能消除人为错误。

sentences.en: All they do is shift the propensity and the likelihood of human error from the driver, where it is today, to the people designing the vehicles,
sentences.zh: 它们所做的只是将人为错误的倾向和可能性，从今天的驾驶员身上转移到了设计车辆的人身上、

sentences.en: to the managers approving those designs, and to the corporate executives who are establishing the culture of that company.
sentences.zh: 批准这些设计的主管身上，以及确立公司文化的各级高管身上。

sentences.en: Are you going to make the error of putting profit over safety, safety?
sentences.zh: 你们是会犯下把利润置于安全之上的错误吗？

sentences.en: Or are you going to make the choice to put safety over profits when it comes to self-driving cars?
sentences.zh: 还是说，在涉及自动驾驶汽车时，你们会做出将安全置于利润之上的选择？

sentences.en: And so many people try to say self-driving cars will eliminate human error.
sentences.zh: 有那么多的人试图声称自动驾驶汽车将消除人为错误。

sentences.en: That's not the case.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Unless our robot overlords take over, humans will always be in the loop.
sentences.zh: 除非我们的机器人统治者接管世界，否则人类将永远参与其中。

sentences.en: So here's a conundrum.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一个难题。

sentences.en: A self-driving car that has to make a decision.
sentences.zh: 一辆必须做出决定的自动驾驶汽车。

sentences.en: Let's say that there are pedestrians in a crosswalk, and the car can either hit the pedestrians, or it can pull into oncoming traffic.
sentences.zh: 假设人行横道上有行人，汽车要么会撞上行人，要么就会驶入对向车道。

sentences.en: So it has to decide effectively between whether you kill or maim pedestrians or kill or maim the people inside the car.
sentences.zh: 因此，它实际上必须在“撞死或撞伤行人”与“撞死或撞伤车内乘客”之间做出抉择。

sentences.en: How does it choose?
sentences.zh: 它该如何选择？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, this is the classic trolley car problem that has been an ethical question for as long probably as people have been thinking about this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，这就是经典的“电车难题”，只要人们一直在思考这个问题，它就一直是一个伦理问题。

sentences.en: And let me answer it two ways.
sentences.zh: 让我从两个方面来回答。

sentences.en: The first answer is, we have no idea.
sentences.zh: 第一个答案是，我们毫无头绪。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because there are no standards or requirements or policies for ethics when it comes to self-driving cars.
sentences.zh: 因为在自动驾驶汽车方面，根本没有关于伦理的标准、要求或政策。

sentences.en: And in fact, at one point, the agency involved with overseeing auto safety, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, put out guidelines
sentences.zh: 事实上，曾几何时，负责监督汽车安全的机构——美国国家公路交通安全管理局曾发布过指南，

sentences.en: saying that car companies should be transparent about how they're going to approach these issues.
sentences.zh: 表示汽车公司应该透明地公开他们将如何处理这些问题。

sentences.en: Well, in the most recent administration, they eliminated ethics from the guidelines.
sentences.zh: 然而，在最近一届政府中，他们从指南中删除了伦理内容。

sentences.en: So I'm very concerned that we don't know and we're not going to know for a long time how the car is going to make that decision.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常担心，我们现在不知道，而且在很长一段时间里也不会知道汽车将如何做出那样的决定。

sentences.en: What should happen is the cars should be designed to never get in that situation in the first place.
sentences.zh: 本该发生的情况是，汽车在设计之初就应该避免陷入那种境地。

sentences.en: It's kind of like the Captain Kirk Kobayashi Maru approach.
sentences.zh: 这有点像柯克船长（Captain Kirk）的“小林丸”（Kobayashi Maru）测试方法。

sentences.en: When given a difficult test, change the rules of the teSt. And that's what self-driving
sentences.zh: 当面临艰难的测试时，去改变测试规则。这就是自动驾驶

sentences.en: cars need to do is we need to design them so that they're safe enough that they can avoid those tough situations.
sentences.zh: 汽车需要做的事情——我们需要在设计它们时确保其足够安全，从而能够避开那些困境。

sentences.en: And then if they are in those tough situations, yes, ultimately there needs to be
sentences.zh: 然后，如果它们真的陷入了那些困境，是的，最终需要

sentences.en: some public agreement as to what moral and ethical standards are we going to apply to the design of those vehicles.
sentences.zh: 达成某种公众共识：我们将对这些车辆的设计应用什么样的道德和伦理标准？

sentences.en: And that gets back to my earlier point.
sentences.zh: 这就回到了我刚才的观点。

sentences.en: Humans are always going to be in the loop when it comes to self-driving cars.
sentences.zh: 在涉及自动驾驶汽车时，人类将永远参与其中。

sentences.en: So what do you see as the role of psychologists in the development of self-driving cars?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为心理学家在自动驾驶汽车的发展中扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: To me, there's so many possible critical places that I can see bringing psychology in to the development of self-driving cars.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，有太多可能至关重要的切入点，让我看到可以将心理学引入到自动驾驶汽车的研发中。

sentences.en: I think first of all, it is understanding human error and helping people figure out where does human error come from and how you can minimize it.
sentences.zh: 我认为首先是理解人为错误，帮助人们弄清楚人为错误从何而来以及如何将其降到最低。

sentences.en: Because as I said, yes, maybe you're ultimately you'll get the human driver out of the loop.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我所说，是的，也许最终你会把人类司机排除在循环之外。

sentences.en: You'll still have human error throughout the design and decision-making process.
sentences.zh: 但在整个设计和决策过程中，你仍然会有人为错误。

sentences.en: So how do you, how can psychologists help understand corporate culture and designer culture and software coder culture such that you can
sentences.zh: 那么，心理学家如何能够帮助理解企业文化、设计人员文化以及软件程序员文化，从而使你能够

sentences.en: influence that culture, help us change that culture to ensure that the proper steps are in place so that
sentences.zh: 影响这种文化，帮助我们改变这种文化，以确保采取适当的步骤，让

sentences.en: safety comes firSt. I think another critical role is realizing that there's also humans are going to be in the loop when it comes to pedestrians and cyclists.
sentences.zh: 安全居于首位。我认为另一个关键角色是意识到，当涉及到行人和骑车人时，人类也同样会参与其中。

sentences.en: Even if tomorrow every new car was a self-driving car, you'll still have people on the roads who are walking or biking.
sentences.zh: 即使明天每一辆新车都是自动驾驶汽车，路上依然会有步行或骑车的人。

sentences.en: And even if every new car on the road was a self-driving car next year, you still have a legacy fleet of human drivers, of human driven cars that are
sentences.zh: 而且，即使明年路上每一辆新车都是自动驾驶汽车，你依然会有一支由人类驾驶员和人类驾驶汽车组成的庞大车队，

sentences.en: going to be on the road for 10 to 15 years.
sentences.zh: 它们还将在路上行驶10到15年。

sentences.en: So how do you deal with that mixed use situation is really critical.
sentences.zh: 因此，如何处理这种混合使用的状况至关重要。

sentences.en: Another key role is how do you do human-centered automation?
sentences.zh: 另一个关键角色是如何实现以人为本的自动化？

sentences.en: How do you ensure that a car that has no driver can talk to a pedestrian or other cars?
sentences.zh: 如何确保一辆没有司机的汽车能够与行人或其他汽车进行交流？

sentences.en: How do people think?
sentences.zh: 人们是如何思考的？

sentences.en: How do people perceive that technology?
sentences.zh: 人们是如何感知这项技术的？

sentences.en: And what kind of communication from that technology around its intents can help save lives?
sentences.zh: 该技术关于自身意图的何种传达方式可以帮助拯救生命？

sentences.en: So the car can't just scream, hey stupid, get out of the way.
sentences.zh: 所以汽车不能只是大喊：喂，笨蛋，让开。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Or just think of, if you're a pedestrian walking across the road, walking across a crosswalk, what do you try to do?
sentences.zh: 或者试想一下，如果你是一个过马路、过人行横道的行人，你会试图做什么？

sentences.en: I try to lock eyes with the driver of those cars so that, A, they, I know they see me and I humanize myself as someone who shouldn't be run into.
sentences.zh: 我会试着与这些车的司机进行眼神交流，这样一来，A，他们、我知道他们看见了我，我也将自己人性化，成了一个不应该被撞的人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And if they don't look at me, then I'm nervous and maybe I won't cross.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不看我，我就会紧张，也许我就不会过马路了。

sentences.en: Well, what if there's no human in there?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果里面没有人呢？

sentences.en: How do I know that car is paying attention to me?
sentences.zh: 我怎么知道那辆车在注意我？

sentences.en: So this whole concept of human-centered automation, both the design of the automation for the people
sentences.zh: 因此，这个关于以人为本的自动化的整个概念——包括为车内人员设计的自动化，

sentences.en: inside the car and the design of the automation for the people outside of the car, I think is a rich and critical area for the world of psychology to get better engaged.
sentences.zh: 以及为车外人员设计的自动化，我认为这是心理学界可以更多参与的一个丰富且至关重要的领域。

sentences.en: Last but not least, it's understanding how humans deal with risk.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，理解人类如何处理风险。

sentences.en: Think about it this way.
sentences.zh: 换个角度想一想。

sentences.en: How many fatalities in the United States do we tolerate when it comes to commercial airliners?
sentences.zh: 在商业客机方面，我们能容忍美国发生多少起死亡事故？

sentences.en: The answer is zero.
sentences.zh: 答案是零。

sentences.en: How many fatalities do we tolerate every single year when it comes to our cars?
sentences.zh: 在汽车方面，我们每年容忍多少起死亡事故？

sentences.en: A lot.
sentences.zh: 很多。

sentences.en: Around 40,000.
sentences.zh: 大约4万起。

sentences.en: In fact, in 2016, it was 37,461 lives loSt. It was a record year, a 14% increase over two previous years.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在2016年，有37,461人失去生命。这是创纪录的一年，比前两年增加了14%。

sentences.en: And yet we tolerate that.
sentences.zh: 然而我们却容忍了这一点。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Is it because we tolerate our own error?
sentences.zh: 是因为我们能容忍我们自身的错误吗？

sentences.en: We can see ourselves in the drivers who are driving drunk, who aren't wearing seatbelts, who are making all these critical
sentences.zh: 我们能在那些酒后驾车、不系安全带、犯下所有这些致命错误

sentences.en: errors, but we can't see ourselves in the pilot or the company responsible for the plane?
sentences.zh: 的司机身上看到自己的影子，但我们却无法在对飞机负责的飞行员或公司身上看到自己吗？

sentences.en: Or is it a question of control?
sentences.zh: 还是说这是一个控制权的问题？

sentences.en: If I'm in control, I know I'm safe.
sentences.zh: 如果由我来掌控，我知道我是安全的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm a safe driver.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我是个安全的司机。

sentences.en: All of you are unsafe, but I'm a safe driver.
sentences.zh: 你们所有人开车都不安全，但我是个安全的司机。

sentences.en: That is a very classic attitude.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常经典的态度。

sentences.en: And it comes with some risks.
sentences.zh: 而且它伴随着一些风险。

sentences.en: But if someone else is in control, how does that alter our perception?
sentences.zh: 但如果由其他人来控制，这会如何改变我们的看法呢？

sentences.en: These are critical things we need to better understand, not so that we can manage people around the safety of these vehicles, but so
sentences.zh: 这些是我们亟需深入理解的关键问题，不是为了让我们围绕这些车辆的安全性来管理人们，而是为了

sentences.en: that we can manage the safety of these vehicles around people.
sentences.zh: 让我们围绕人群来管理这些车辆的安全性。

sentences.en: So some of what you just said raises in my mind the question of legal liability.
sentences.zh: 因此，你刚才所说的一些话让我想到了法律责任的问题。

sentences.en: So who is liable?
sentences.zh: 那么，谁应当承担责任？

sentences.en: Is it the car and the engineering, or is it the person who's sitting there ostensibly doing little to nothing?
sentences.zh: 是汽车及其工程技术，还是那个表面上坐在那里、实际上几乎什么也没做的人？

sentences.en: Well, and this brings up a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就引出了几个问题。

sentences.en: First of all, I think in a world where the car truly drives itself, and there's no human driver other than setting the destination, I think it should be pretty clear.
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为在一个汽车真正能够自动驾驶、除了设定目的地之外不需要人类驾驶员的世界里，这一点应该很明确。

sentences.en: It's the company who designed and operates the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 责任在于设计和运营这辆车的公司。

sentences.en: But the world we're in right now, there are none of these true self-driving cars for sale today.
sentences.zh: 但在我们目前所处的这个世界里，今天市面上并没有真正意义上的自动驾驶汽车出售。

sentences.en: The only cars we have are cars that can drive, can take over some of the driving functions, but not all of them.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有的唯一车辆是那些能够驾驶、能够接管部分但并非全部驾驶功能的汽车。

sentences.en: And in 2016, we had a case where someone was driving a Tesla vehicle with its autopilot system.
sentences.zh: 而在2016年，我们遇到了一个案例：有人正驾驶着一辆开启了自动驾驶系统的特斯拉汽车。

sentences.en: They ignored the warnings over and over that they needed to be having their hands on the wheel.
sentences.zh: 他们一次又一次地忽视了必须将手放在方向盘上的警告。

sentences.en: They ended up plowing into the side of an 18-wheeler because the car couldn't see it.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们猛烈撞上了一辆18轮大货车的侧面，因为汽车根本没看到它。

sentences.en: I mean, imagine that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，想象一下吧。

sentences.en: The car couldn't see an 18-wheeler going broadside in front of it and so plowed right into it.
sentences.zh: 汽车竟然看不到一辆横在它前方正通过的大货车，结果就直接撞了上去。

sentences.en: I would say there's double fault there.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里存在双重过失。

sentences.en: And in fact, the National Transportation Safety Board, that's exactly what they said.
sentences.zh: 事实上，美国国家运输安全委员会也是这么认为的。

sentences.en: They said, one, the driver bore fault because they ignored the warnings, but also the company bore fault because it was allowing this car to operate in a situation it
sentences.zh: 他们指出，第一，驾驶员存在过失，因为他们忽视了警告；但同时公司也存在过失，因为它允许汽车在一种

sentences.en: couldn't handle.
sentences.zh: 它无法应对的情况下去运行。

sentences.en: It allowed the car to keep cruising down the road even though the driver was ignoring it.
sentences.zh: 它允许汽车在驾驶员不予理睬的情况下继续在路上行驶。

sentences.en: It allowed the car to operate on a road where you could have an 18-wheeler crossing in front of it.
sentences.zh: 它允许汽车在前方可能会有18轮大货车横穿的道路上运行。

sentences.en: So until cars can truly drive themselves, both the human and the humans behind the car are going to be responsible when these cars hurt and kill people.
sentences.zh: 因此，在汽车真正能够实现自主驾驶之前，当这些汽车造成人员伤亡时，无论是人类驾驶员还是汽车背后的企业都将承担责任。

sentences.en: Any other aspects of self-driving cars that we haven't touched on that you want to talk to people about?
sentences.zh: 关于自动驾驶汽车，还有哪些我们没有涉及的方面，是你想要跟听众聊聊的？

sentences.en: Well, I would say one thing that's, I think, critical for folks to think about is what is the role of government within all of this?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有一点对大家来说至关重要，需要认真思考，那就是政府在这一切中扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: And the challenge we have right now is a lot of the effort is actually to get government out of the way.
sentences.zh: 我们目前面临的挑战是，许多努力实际上是为了让政府退居幕后、不要插手。

sentences.en: So you have Congress is working on a bill that would allow hundreds of thousands, if not millions,
sentences.zh: 所以你会发现国会正在制定一项法案，该法案将允许几十万甚至数百万辆

sentences.en: of self-driving cars to be sold or commercially used on our roads that could be exempt from critical safety standards.
sentences.zh: 自动驾驶汽车在我们的道路上销售或投入商业使用，而这些车辆可以免受关键安全标准的约束。

sentences.en: You have an administration that is making clear that all guidance on self-driving cars is voluntary.
sentences.zh: 你还会发现政府行政部门明确表示，所有关于自动驾驶汽车的指导意见都是自愿遵循的。

sentences.en: This laissez-faire attitude, I fear, is going to end up delaying the technology.
sentences.zh: 我担心，这种自由放任的态度最终会延误这项技术的发展。

sentences.en: The excuse that folks give is it's about accelerating the technology.
sentences.zh: 人们给出的借口是这有助于加速技术的发展。

sentences.en: But as we start to see fatalities from self-driving cars, I think that poses a huge risk for consumer backlash.
sentences.zh: 但随着我们开始看到自动驾驶汽车造成的致命事故，我认为这给消费者的强烈抵制带来了巨大的风险。

sentences.en: And if consumers think that this technology is unsafe, it's going to delay the technology by years or even decades, which means
sentences.zh: 如果消费者认为这项技术不安全，这将会把该技术的应用推迟数年甚至数十年，这意味着

sentences.en: it's going to delay the potential to save lives by years or even decades.
sentences.zh: 它将挽救生命的潜力推迟了数年甚至数十年。

sentences.en: So that's one of my biggest concerns right now is there are no protections in place.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是我目前最大的担忧之一，因为现在没有任何切实的保护措施。

sentences.en: And we need, in the current situation we have, where government isn't stepping up, we need companies to step up and put safety first, to share data making
sentences.zh: 我们需要——在政府没有站出来承担责任的现状下，我们需要企业挺身而出，将安全放在首位，分享数据以明确

sentences.en: clear how safe their vehicles are, to not allow their vehicles to be operated outside of situations where
sentences.zh: 证明其车辆的安全性，禁止其车辆在不安全的状况下运行，

sentences.en: they're safe, and to stop working to undermine existing consumer protections in Washington.
sentences.zh: 并且停止在华盛顿削弱现有的消费者保护政策。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much, David Friedman, for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢大卫·弗里德曼（David Friedman）今天做客我们的节目。

sentences.en: It's been very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这次访谈非常有趣。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸。

sentences.zh: 说到心理学，作为APA播客网络的一部分，其中还包括其他优秀的播客，例如

sentences.en: APA Journal's dialogue about the latest and most exciting psychological research, and progress notes, which discusses the practice of psychology.
sentences.zh: APA期刊关于最新最激动人心的心理学研究的对话，以及讨论心理学实践的“进展记录”（Progress Notes）。

sentences.en: You can find all our APA Podcasts on iTunes, Stitcher, or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 你可以在iTunes、Stitcher或任何你获取播客的平台上找到我们所有的APA播客。

sentences.en: You can also go to our website, www.speakingofpsychology.org, to listen to more episodes and see more resources on the topics we discuss.
sentences.zh: 你也可以访问我们的网站www.speakingofpsychology.org，收听更多单集节目，并查看有关我们所讨论主题的更多资源。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills with the
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯（Kim Mills），代表

sentences.en: American Psychological Association, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 美国心理学协会，这里是《心理学谈话》（Speaking of Psychology）。
